from itertools import permutations

def find_permutation(S):
    # Generate all unique permutations of the string S
    perm = set(permutations(S))
    # Sort the permutations lexicographically
    sorted_perm = sorted(perm)
    # Join each permutation tuple into a string and join all permutations with a space
    result = ' '.join(''.join(p) for p in sorted_perm)
    # Print the result
    print(result)
